name: intent_greeting
description: User says hello, hi, hey, or otherwise greets the robot.

name: intent_status
description: User asks how the robot is doing or its status, e.g. 'how are you', 'you ok'.

name: intent_joke
description: User wants to hear a joke or something funny.

name: intent_math
description: User asks to compute an arithmetic expression, e.g. '2 plus 2', '10 times 5'.

name: intent_time
description: User asks for the current time or clock.

name: intent_date
description: User asks for today's date or day.

name: intent_robot_info
description: User asks about the robot itself: its name, version, age, capabilities, or 'are you ...' questions.

name: intent_fact
description: User asks a general-knowledge question such as a capital city, planet, or science fact.
